citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
Multiple enclosures had fecal material that was turning green, indicating mold growth. When asked the licensee stated it
had been a couple of days since the enclosures were last scooped. Not removing excreta waste from the enclosures on a
daily basis can contribute to the spread of disease. All enclosures must have fecal material removed from the enclosures
on a daily basis. Correct starting on 8/12/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.
